page.layout: One printed page, a digitiser's cover sheet: e-rara logo at top, web address and title block centred, a rule, a block of licence and access notices at the foot, and the Visual Library logo at bottom right. No running text is printed.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet, not part of the book: the e-rara.ch logo, the Visual Library logo, the access notices in German, English, French and Italian, and the bibliographic block (title, author, place and year, library, shelf mark, persistent link) are left out of the transcription, as they are not printed matter of this book. The title block reads: Responsio ad maledicum Francisci Stancari Mantuani librum adversus Tigurinae ecclesiae ministros, de trinitate & mediatore domino nostro Iesu Christo; Simmler, Josias; Tiguri, 1563.
